name: System Logs
description: Counts and findings refer only to the selected device, source and filters. They do not certify the health of the whole system.
capabilities: Sources are discovered on this machine. Inventory refreshes every 15 seconds; select a row to read it.
Recognizable secrets are redacted in both the view and exports. Review files before sharing them.
Only server audit events explicitly linked to this device are available. The device does not expose its own remote logs.
